description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

## [0.8.0] - 2026-08-27

Implements social group watching, synchronized playback, and interactive ranking sessions.

### Features

• Group Watch integration backed by native Jellyfin SyncPlay
• Real-time in-player Group Watch chat panel with clickable watch cards
• Interactive ranking sessions with voting brackets and countdown auto-resolve
• Buffer synchronization across joining group members

## [0.6.0] - 2026-08-24

Introduces multi-user profiles, avatar selection, and enhanced watchlist management.

### Features

• Avatar presets controller, SVG avatar categories, and sidebar avatar picker
• Remembered-user quick sign-in and public user grid on login screen
• Rebrand Favorites to Watchlist with inline card quick actions
• Account settings screen with password change and session termination

## [0.7.0] - 2026-08-25

Adds brand identity assets, boot splash video reveal, and external streaming service directory.

### Features

• Streaming hub directory with service branding marks and external links
• Animated jellyfish boot splash video reveal with smooth view transitions
• Progressive asset preloading pipeline for hero carousels and row thumbnails
• Studio hub pages with custom hero banners and catalog rows

## [0.9.0] - 2026-09-03

Production release with comprehensive security audit hardening, memory optimizations, and architecture refactoring.

### Features

• Redesign settings screen with grouped list cards and admin dashboard link
• Automatic Intro and Credits skip detection via native Media Segments API
• Server administrator broadcast message notification service
• Multi-tiered in-memory and ETag caching layer across navigation

### Refactor

• Consolidate disparate user JSON storage into unified atomic JsonUserStore
• Unified DOM element builder helper and date/time formatting utilities

### Bug Fixes

• Enforce decode-time memory caps on profile banner uploads
• Decouple request timeouts to prevent image starvation during slow fetches
• Fix search result state restoration on browser back-button navigation
